title: Two-factor projection interchange for an arbitrary scalar arrow
statement:
Let l be prime, c a finite-extension or algebraic-closure coefficient index, k a field of prime characteristic p different from l, and Y any k-scheme. Use [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pretrace-data] and [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pull-comparison]. Put Lambda=(coefficient l c).X, F=q*, U=Rp2*, P=p1*, T_W=L_W[2], H=(-)(1)[2], M=H(FK), and e2 the specified second-line comparison. For arbitrary unbounded derived K,V on Y and any arrow z:F(V) to U(T_W),
S_K,V ; H(mu_q(K,V)^(-1) ; (identity_FK tensor z) ; D_K) ; twistProjection_p2(P M) = (identity_M tensor z) ; secondForwardProjection_K.
Here D_K, S and both projections are exactly the fixed composites in the cited nodes. This equality has no exchange map or inverse projection and has no invertibility hypotheses.

source.place: Second identity: extraction of q*K and cancellation of the projection, before applying a trace.

proof.text: Expand S and use tensorShiftIso naturality to cancel the monoidal tensorator with the inverse displayed inside H. Thus only the native associators and interchange of the outside line with F(V) remain.

Apply the two-factor projection identity for p2. Naturality in its second input moves the arbitrary z to the source. Use the root-normalized comparisons to identify both pulled lines with L_W[2]. On a root frame their self-interchange is identity: the underlying rank-one line gives ab=ba and the two degree-two shifts give (-1)^4=1. The local equality descends and survives totalization.

Cancel the first pullTwistIso in D_K against the one in secondPullComparison. Its remaining factors are the twist of the self-square comparison and the inverse second pullTwistIso. The tensorShiftIso pairs cancel. This is precisely the defining forward word secondForwardProjection.

lean.statement:
theorem second_projection_interchange
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    (K V : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y))
    (z : (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj V ⟶
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (secondProjection Y)).obj
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules (coefficient l c).X (diagonalSurface Y))
          0).obj (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) :
    let Λ := (coefficient l c).X
    let F := moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
    let H := twist Λ (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (secondTraceStrength Λ Y (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) K V).hom ≫
        H.map ((secondTraceTensorIso Λ Y K V).inv ≫
          (F.obj K ◁ z) ≫ secondExtractProjection l c k p hpl Y K) ≫
        twistProjectionMap Λ (secondProjection Y)
          (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y)) (line l c (diagonalSurface Y))
          (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y)
          ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (firstProjection Y)).obj (H.obj (F.obj K))) =
      (H.obj (F.obj K) ◁ z) ≫ secondForwardProjection l c k p hpl Y K
